sources.title: BAAI/bge-reranker-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: New reranker model: release cross-encoder models BAAI/bge-reranker-base and BAAI/bge-reranker-large, which are more powerful than embedding model. We recommend to use/fine-tune them to re-rank top-k documents returned by embedding models.

sources.title: BGE Reranker base | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: BGE Reranker base is BAAI's lighter first-generation cross-encoder reranker for English and Chinese. It directly scores query-document relevance rather than producing embeddings, and is positioned as the faster, easier-to-deploy reranking option in the original BGE reranker family.

sources.title: BGE-Reranker — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: For examples, use a bge embedding model to first retrieve top 100 relevant documents, and then use bge reranker to re-rank the top 100 document to get the final top-3 results. The first series of BGE-Reranker contains two models, large and base.

sources.title: bge
sources.snippet: Intro to BGE Models BGE builds a one-stop retrieval toolkit for search and RAG. We provide inference, evaluation, and fine-tuning for embedding models and reranker.
